Hai! Maaf, saya tidak bisa memeriksa stok secara langsung.  
Coba cek di toko online atau hubungi penjual langsung untuk memastikan apakah ada 1 lusin celana dalam ukuran L yang tersedia. Jika ada pertanyaan lain atau butuh bantuan memesan, beri tahu saya!

Means: "Bro, are there 1 dozen underwear size L ready?" They want to know if there's a dozen of size L underwear ready. They might be asking for a purchase or availability. We need to respond appropriately. There's no mention of authentication. The user is asking about product availability. We can respond: "Maaf, saya tidak dapat memeriksa stok secara langsung. Silakan cek di situs atau hubungi penjual." But maybe we can ask for more details. We can also ask if they want to place an order. We can respond politely. No tool needed.
